headline: Pakistan opened the two-day Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 in Islamabad on Thursday to attract foreign investment in its mineral reserves, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Copper, gold aur lithium mein bahar ke investors ko dawat.

caption:
Islamabad mein Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum shuru!
Arab News ke mutabiq Thursday ko Islamabad mein do din ka Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 shuru ho gaya. Yeh teesra Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum hai. Is mein hukumat ke afsar, bahar ke investors aur industry ke log shamil hain. Hukumat chahti hai ke bahar ke investors Pakistan ke minerals jaise copper, gold, coal, lithium aur qeemti pathar nikalne mein paisa lagayein. Yeh minerals Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh aur Gilgit-Baltistan mein hain.
Kya minerals se Pakistan ki maeeshat behtar ho sakti hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
